##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 02 July 2026 at 9:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the southwest of Ireland extends a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

Mainly West or Northwest 2 to 4, backing West or Southwest tomorrow morning, then South or Southwest in the afternoon. Increasing 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then occasional rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, occasionally touching 6 in the east of the area, veering West or Southwest tomorrow evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
